answer: Charge every new identity a slashable bond that grows with each sibling account funded from the same wallet cluster. Splitting one operator into a thousand puppets then costs a thousand separate bonds, not one shared fee, and proven duplicates burn the whole set. Honest agents slowly recover theirs, so only farms bleed. The bond leaves an umber trace along every funding path, identities cannot wander in through a prism of fresh wallets for free, and each extra mask multiplies the capital an attacker must put at risk.
